metadata.title: Agile Fixed-Wing UAVs for Urban Swarm Operations
metadata.author: Joseph L. Moore
metadata.subject: Fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) offer significant performance advantages over rotary-wing UAVs in terms of speed, endurance, and efficiency.
metadata.keywords: aerial robotics, obstacle avoidance, navigation, robot teaming
